SELECT t.`auth_id` as authId, t.`owner_type` as ownerType, CASE WHEN t.owner_type = 'Role' THEN r.ROLE_NAME ELSE t.owner_id END AS ownerId, t.`module_code` as moduleCode, t.`module_name` as moduleName, t.`dim_code` as dimCode, t.`dim_name` as dimName, t.`item_code` as itemCode, t.`item_value` as itemValue , t.`remark` , DATE_FORMAT( t.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS createdTime, t.`created_by` as createdBy FROM bi_portal.sys_data_auth t LEFT JOIN bi_portal.sys_role r ON t.`owner_id` = r.`ROLE_ID` where 1=1
ORDER BY createdTime desc,dimName LIMIT ${pageRowLower}, ${prePageSize}

SELECT DISTINCT tmp.* FROM (SELECT t1.`owner_id` AS ownerId, t1.`module_code` as moduleCode, t1.`module_name` as moduleName, t1.`dim_code` as dimCode, t1.`dim_name` as dimName, t1.`item_code` as itemCode, t1.`item_value` as itemValue FROM bi_portal.sys_data_auth t1 WHERE t1.`owner_type` = 'User' UNION ALL SELECT t2.user_name as ownerId, t1.`module_code` as moduleCode, t1.`module_name` as moduleName, t1.`dim_code` as dimCode, t1.`dim_name` as dimName, t1.`item_code` as itemCode, t1.`item_value` as itemValue FROM bi_portal.sys_data_auth t1 INNER JOIN bi_portal.sys_user_role t2 ON t1.`owner_id` = t2.role_id AND t1.`owner_type` = 'Role' WHERE 1 = 1) tmp
